name: replenishment-reminder
description: Learns how often customers rebuy each consumable product, such as coffee, candles or skincare, and reminds them just before they run out, with Klaviyo or a Resend email you approve.

howItWorks.label: Learns
howItWorks.text: Each consumable product's typical time between repeat orders, from your order history

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Customers about to run out, who accept marketing email and have not reordered

howItWorks.label: Reminds
howItWorks.text: Through a Klaviyo flow, or a short Resend email you approve

howItWorks.label: Remembers
howItWorks.text: Who was reminded for which order, so nobody is reminded twice

plugins.reason: Sets the reminder date on the customer's profile so your Klaviyo flow sends it, with Klaviyo's own consent and unsubscribe handling
Sends each approved reminder email directly

data.description: The customer's first name, for the greeting
Whether the customer agreed to receive marketing email
The customer who placed the order
What each order contained (product and quantity)
Marks the products people use up and rebuy; without it, setup asks which products count
How many days one unit usually lasts, when the store knows it (overrides the learned interval)
The product's page on the store, for the reorder link

parameters.label: Remind this many days early
parameters.description: The reminder goes out this many days before the customer is expected to run out

parameters.label: Repeat orders needed to learn
parameters.description: A product needs at least this many repeat purchases before its interval is trusted

parameters.label: Reminders per run
parameters.description: The most reminders in one run; the rest wait for tomorrow

parameters.label: Where customers reply
parameters.description: The address for replies when sending with Resend, e.g. hello@northline.example
